# QuantyCoin (QTY) — Protocol QTY4 Machine Index
> Independent Post-Quantum Dual-PoW Layer-1 Cryptocurrency featuring SHA-256D ASIC and Scrypt CPU/GPU mining, NIST FIPS 204 ML-DSA-44 transaction authorization, thermodynamic cumulative chainwork, pure 64-bit integer monetary arithmetic, native Stratum V2 binary engine, and Qt6 desktop applications.

## Core Technical Summary
- **Protocol Version:** 70040 (QTY4 / v4.0.0 Mainnet)
- **Chain Identifier:** quantycoin-4.0
- **Genesis Block Hash:** 000004eb1e117df3168d6d27118982e0a23c236120183e8390a6bbb82ee6fde3
- **Consensus:** Asymmetric Dual-PoW (Lane A SHA-256D ASIC & Lane B RFC 7914 Scrypt) with LWMA-1 difficulty adjustment (window: 45 blocks per lane)
- **Fork Choice:** Cumulative Thermodynamic Chainwork ($W_A=1, W_B=2048$)
- **Max Supply:** 21,000,000 QTY (2.1 x 10^15 Satoshis) enforced via checked 64-bit integer arithmetic (`core.money.Amount`)
- **Target Block Time:** 60 seconds combined (120 seconds per lane)
- **Block Reward:** Lane A: 50 QTY &bull; Lane B: 25 QTY, halving every 2,100,000 blocks (~4 years) via pure integer right-shift
- **Max Block Size:** 32 MB (33,554,432 bytes)
- **Network Ports:** P2P: 19444, RPC: 19445, Stratum V1: 3333, Stratum V2: 3334
- **Wire Magic:** `0x51545934` ("QTY4")
- **Post-Quantum Cryptography:** NIST FIPS 204 ML-DSA-44 native C lattice acceleration (`libqtydilithium`)
- **Address Schemes:** Native SegWit Bech32 (`qty1q...`), Post-Quantum Bech32m (`qty1p...`), Hybrid Bech32m (`qty1z...`), Legacy Base58Check (`Q...`)
- **Native Applications:** Sovereign Full Wallet, SPV Lightning Wallet, Node Manager GUI, Standalone Miner GUI, and Combined Master Suite (Qt6 / PySide6 for Windows & Linux).
